tool_args.rationale: The bridge signature explicitly maps W1 to the inland-hub siphon. The varied-gradient probe reveals strong sink inhibition; fit the documented saturating siphon base and numerically compare the allowed square-root and leak branches on all paid rows. The earlier execution failures referenced an undefined training-row global; this implementation stores fitted parameters in fit() and uses them in predict().

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The purchased probe already varied sink gradient and yielded seven rows across the relevant range, identifying inhibition sufficiently to fit the bridge law.

considered_alternatives.option: Extra fine trajectory batch / coupled-memory ODE
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The W1 bridge maps to the static two-layer siphon response; all observations share a fixed horizon and show no evidence requiring trajectory data.

considered_alternatives.option: Static quadratic or Michaelis-Menten without sink inhibition
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The high-sink row is substantially lower despite comparable input, inconsistent with models that ignore s_grad.
